description: Retrieves the authenticated user's pending Chat message requests from one inbox. Message contents are end-to-end encrypted unless the conversation is unencrypted. Accepting or deleting requests between pages can skip or repeat requests, and a page can be empty while `next_token` is set.

chat_message_request.fields.description: A comma separated list of ChatMessageRequest fields to display.

max_results.description: The maximum number of message requests to return.

pagination_token.description: The next_token from a previous response, to fetch the next page.
